name: SDSS-RM RMID 191 (Hubble)
blurb: SDSS-RM RMID 191, a quasar and its host galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: rm191-hubble
story: At the center of this galaxy shines a quasar whose black hole was weighed by reverberation mapping, timing the delay as light from its disk echoes off surrounding gas. Hubble imaged the host galaxy to see how the black hole's mass relates to the galaxy's stars.

claims.text: RM191 is a quasar target of Hubble program 15849 on AGN with reverberation-mapping black hole masses
The black hole masses come from reverberation mapping, which uses the time delay between the accretion disk and the broad-line gas
Hubble imaging measured host stellar masses to study the black hole mass-stellar mass relation
